text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency Spike detected for /generate-stream (region: us-west). p99=2200ms (SLO=1000ms), p95=780ms. Error rate stable. Paging oncall.

sara.m: got the page, looking now. any change in traffic? :eyes:

david.r: seeing a big tail in tokenizer service (tokenizer-preproc-v2). queue depth up ~7x on a subset of hosts.

deepa: confirming. sample traces show long stalls inside prompt-template expansion + JSON mode parse step. a few traces show 200-800ms spent in `render_tool_schema()` before streaming kicks in.

toni: could be the recent tool-schema change that inlines heavy JSON validation. rolling back would be quick if we suspect it.

sara.m: can we scale tokenizer-preproc first to reduce tail risk? quick mitigation: scale replicas and reduce max batch size.

oncall-jen: scaling now. running:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/tokenizer-preproc-v2 --replicas=10
kubectl -n prod patch deploy/tokenizer-preproc-v2 -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"tokenizer","env":[{"name":"MAX_BATCH_SIZE","value":"8"}]}]}}}}'
```

ops-bot: Deploy scale request queued to k8s cluster prod-a. ETA ~ 30s.

david.r: while that lands, can we short-circuit JSON mode for streaming requests? toggle flag on ingress to send `streaming_json=false` for customers on streaming plan.

deepa: yes, there's a feature flag `enable_jsonmode_streaming` in config-service. I'll flip for prod.

sara.m: flipping now and patching a fast fallback for templates that exceed render time >200ms (will skip heavy tool-schema expansion).

toni: created a rate-limit for template compilation: `template_compiler.max_parallel=4` and set a 150ms soft timeout for expansion.

oncall-jen: scale confirmed, replicas=10. latency p99 dropped from 2200ms -> 1400ms preliminary.

david.r: still seeing streaming stalls on p99 ~1.4s. p95 steady at ~700ms. traces show fewer long `render_tool_schema()` but more CPU queuing on a couple of nodes.

sara.m: marking mitigation: scaled tokenizer, reduced batch size, disabled JSON streaming, added template compile limits. next: rotate traffic off two noisy hosts and gather heap/profiles.

deepa: capturing heap + flamegraphs from tokenizer-preproc-v2 pod xz-7 now: `curl http://xz-7:6060/debug/pprof/heap` and `go tool pprof` instructions in incident doc.

toni: I see a correlation: customers using complex tool schemas + JSON mode (multi-tool calls) make prompt builder expand very large objects. Suggest immediate tactical: for streaming endpoints, avoid full tool-schema hydration until post-first-token. basically stream first token, then hydrate heavy schema in background.

sara.m: agree. implementing a small change in prompt-constructor: if `streaming=true && schema_size>50kb` then emit placeholder and continue streaming. will push a hotfix.

oncall-jen: hotfix deployed to 20% at edge, verifying. No errors reported so far.

ops-bot: Edge canary logs: no 5xx, streaming latency p99 in canary down to 850ms.

david.r: customer-impact check: which customers saw degraded streaming? data shows 18 customers had p99 > 1s, 4 customers > 2s. largest impacted: acme-inc (API key ak-xxx), but their error rate didn't spike — just latency.

sara.m: reaching out to CSM for ACME with note and temporary workaround (suggest reduce max_tokens and disable tool-schema usage for streaming call).

deepa: recording the initial cause as heavy prompt-template/tool-schema expansion in JSON mode causing CPU stalls and IO waits at prompt-constructor, exacerbated by high batch sizes.

toni: will open PR to make schema hydration lazy + add telemetry for schema_size per request.

oncall-jen: handing to daytime oncall (sara.m) for next 2 hours. I'll remain on-call if anything regresses. :handshake:

sara.m: taking post-mitigation watch. I'll monitor p95/p99 for next 30m and update incident channel.

david.r: next actions for postmortem:
- root cause: template/tool-schema heavy expansion + JSON streaming path causing blocking work.
- mitigations applied: scaled tokenizer replicas, reduced max batch size, disabled JSON-streaming, template compile timeout, streaming placeholder hotfix.
- follow-ups: lazy schema hydration PR, telemetry (schema_size), add auto throttling when template render time >150ms, consider CPU autoscaling rules per host.

sara.m: posting customer-impact summary to #customer-success and creating incident ticket in JIRA INC-4492.

deepa: saving traces + flamegraphs to incident S3: s3://redwood-incidents/3412349876/ and attaching to ticket.

oncall-jen: final status: mitigated -> monitoring. p99 dropped to 920ms in 15m, p95 ~680ms. keeping channel open for 1h.

sara.m: noted. will transition to postmortem drafting after watch window. thanks all for quick responses :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigation applied. Severity downgraded. Watch mode until 3412353476.
